title: Penetration Tester / Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
**Penetration Tester / Cybersecurity Specialist**

**Company:** Knowtifics Technologies  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 5 - 8Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time / Contract  
**Industry:** Cybersecurity | IT Consulting

**Job Summary**

Knowtifics Technologies is looking for experienced **Penetration Testers / Cybersecurity Specialists** with 5–8 years of strong hands-on experience in identifying, validating and reporting security vulnerabilities across **web applications, APIs, networks, infrastructure, cloud and containerized environments**.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently conducting security assessments, performing manual exploitation, preparing professional reports and working with engineering teams through remediation and retesting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform penetration testing and vulnerability assessments for:
* Web applications
* REST APIs
* Networks and infrastructure
* Cloud environments
* Docker and Kubernetes environments
* Test authentication, authorization, session management and access controls.
* Identify and validate vulnerabilities including:
* SQL Injection
* XSS
* SSRF
* IDOR / Broken Access Control
* Authentication vulnerabilities
* Security misconfigurations
* Privilege escalation
* API security vulnerabilities
* Perform manual exploitation and proof-of-concept validation.
* Conduct network and infrastructure security assessments across Linux and Windows.
* Assess AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
* Review CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps security controls.
* Analyze vulnerabilities based on technical and business impact.
* Prepare detailed penetration-testing reports with evidence, risk ratings and remediation recommendations.
* Present findings to developers, architects, security teams and customers.
* Support vulnerability remediation and perform retesting.
* Participate in customer meetings and technical security discussions.

**Required SkillsApplication & API Security**

* OWASP Top 10
* OWASP API Security Top 10
* Authentication & Authorization
* Session Management
* Access Control
* Business Logic Testing
* Injection Vulnerabilities
* SSRF
* API Security Testing

**Penetration Testing Tools**

**Hands-on experience with:**

* **Burp Suite**
* **Nmap**
* **Metasploit**
* Nessus / OpenVAS
* Kali Linux
* Other industry-standard security tools

**Infrastructure & Network Security**

* Practical experience assessing Linux and Windows environments.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and TLS/SSL.
* Knowledge of firewalls, network services, and common infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Familiarity with Active Directory security assessment is preferred.

**Cloud & Container Security**

**Experience with one or more:**

* AWS
* Microsoft Azure
* Google Cloud
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* OpenShift

DevSecOps & Automation

* Git and CI/CD pipelines
* DevSecOps security practices
* Secrets management
* Dependency/security scanning
* Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar scripting

**Experience**

**5–8 Years**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in penetration testing, VAPT, or application and infrastructure security.
* Proven hands-on experience independently conducting security assessments.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability validation, exploitation techniques, and risk assessment.
* Experience preparing technical reports with clear findings, supporting evidence, and remediation guidance.
* Ability to communicate security findings effectively with technical teams and customers.
* Experience supporting remediation activities and performing retesting.

Preferred Certifications

* OSCP
* OSCE
* OSEP
* CREST
* GPEN
* CEH
* CISSP

**Certifications are an advantage, but practical hands-on penetration-testing experience is more important.**

**Good to Have**

**Experience in:**

* Cloud security
* Kubernetes / OpenShift security
* Mobile application security
* Secure architecture reviews
* DevSecOps / CI/CD security
* AI / LLM application security
* Threat modelling
* Vulnerability management
* Security remediation programs
* Enterprise or telecom environments
* International customer engagements

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for professionals who can **perform real-world penetration testing**, not just manage security activities.

You should be able to:

**Understand → Identify → Exploit → Validate → Report → Remediate → Retest**

Strong analytical skills, professional communication and good written/spoken English are essential.

**Why Join Knowtifics Technologies?**

* Work on real-world enterprise security projects
* Exposure to Cloud, Application, Infrastructure and DevSecOps security
* Work with modern cybersecurity technologies
* Direct interaction with engineering and customer teams
* Career growth opportunities in cybersecurity and security architecture
* Collaborative technology environment

**Job Details**

**Job Title:** Penetration Tester / Cybersecurity Specialist  
**Experience:** 5 - 8 Years  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time / Contract  
**Work Area:** Cybersecurity | VAPT | Application Security | Cloud Security | Infrastructure Security

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their **updated CV/resume** along with relevant certifications and penetration-testing experience to:

**careers@knowtifics.com**

**Subject:** Application – Penetration Tester / Cybersecurity Specialist

Work Location: In person
